display_name: 兔子镜小剧场 / Rabbit Mirror Theater（TEST・生成方式切换・维修兔 v1.78-test）
author: Toto
description: RabbitMirror test build with mutually exclusive generation modes: follow the current API (inline or external presentation), or use a separately configured OpenAI-compatible API/model that receives the current chat text, available reasoning, character card, Persona, world-book/author-note context and produces one message-level external RabbitMirror. Independent mode removes RabbitMirror prompt injection from the current API. Includes safe auto-patrol test. Independent external generation now creates one native RabbitMirror details shell immediately with maintenance rabbit and feedback cat present from the loading state, then updates the same message-level shell in place on success or failure. No fixed prompt is added to the current API in independent mode.
